overall.verdict: The desktop-light variant demonstrates strong visual design with excellent visceral value execution and clear data presentation. The one-scale bar principle is consistently applied across screens, creating an intuitive money visualization system. Typography and layout are generally well-executed, though some screens show inconsistencies in hierarchy and visual noise.
